title: 【老闆急件】先備份並清空既有任務池，改為直接執行；全面重構派工底層
description: 老闆於 Telegram msg 1329 明確指示：第一步先對 storage/next_tasks.json 做可回復備份，之後清空既有任務；暫停把工作送進任務池，所有工作改為直接執行。接著第一個直接執行的工作是全面盤點並重構整個派工／認領／commit／殘留收斂底層，消除無人認領、無法 commit、任務池堵塞與舊機制殘留。這是 user-assigned P1 急件；須直接開工，不可只寫計畫或再拆成一般排隊單。依五步結案 gate：live 證據、根因層級、底層重構、回歸與下游回讀、制度化寫回；未全過只能標 contained。操作含清空任務池，務必先建立可驗證備份並保留回復路徑。完成後以 Telegram 回報短結論與可查證證據。
containment_evidence: Safe reconcile ownership, destructive intent, complete six-table/seven-edge recovery capture, worker execution contract, production delete owner/approval/compare-delete projection, and the exact restore execution contract are root_cause_fixed_and_verified. The restore executor now fail-closes on hash/canonical/scope drift, requires mutation authority, uses an atomic batch projection seam, and requires exact typed read-back. The overall umbrella remains contained because the production service-role atomic restore projection, manual-only live delete-to-restore-to-convergence rehearsal, and physical two-Mac authority receipt pair remain incomplete.
next_direct_step: Implement the production service-role atomic restore projection behind PublisherArticleDeleteRestoreExecutor with ACL, transaction rollback, six-table/seven-edge, replay, and scope-drift failure injections. Then run a manual-only live synthetic delete -> restore -> feed convergence rehearsal while owner transfer and rollback generations are recorded; do not grant destructive authority to the unattended hourly safe job. Separately collect the two-physical-Mac authority receipt pair for program commit 34.
latest_checkpoint: Exact restore now has a single recovery consumer contract: SHA-256 and canonical JSONL validation, complete six-table identity validation, all-candidate absent/exact preflight, required mutation authorization, one atomic restore_batch boundary, exact typed post-readback, and read-only idempotent replay. Adjacent publisher and Effect Delivery suites pass 157/157; no production RPC or remote mutation ran.
